target: Author-extracted cyclist speed one second ahead

input_units.past_acc: m/s^2 from native speed 1 s earlier
input_units.gap: m; positive-angle arc gap to nearest forward angular bicycle
input_units.lateral_gap: m; radial separation to angular leader

timing_contract: Only current and past extracted speeds and current geometry/neighbor state. Future target speed is inaccessible to candidate replay.
calibration: Source computer-vision/Kalman trajectories, 25 Hz; select every 25th frame and exact +/-25-frame pairs. Parts of the same original video remain together. Track IDs may be ambiguous; all 28 riders recur across videos. Source preprocessing may use future smoothing, so predictions are retrospective trajectory dynamics and not certified online safety. Angular-neighbor interaction is a testable approximation; lateral separation and direction reversal are falsifiers.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: One controlled circular-track session, recurring riders; no new-rider, on-road safety or crash-prevention transfer claim.

exposure.historical_record: All packaged targets are exposed for future agents; future scoring is retrospective. Public source-aware corpus. Illustrative header/first-row values were inspected during the semantics audit; these do not constitute blind source acquisition. All delivered targets become exposed after confirmation.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
